notes: No vector exists. The current file (homepage Marvin_circle.png, 383x324) has a white disc behind the head that shows as a white crescent on the dark theme, an added background; the app icon is the mascot as Amazing Marvin's own app icon, a full brown tile that reads on both themes. It is 180px, enough for the 48px icon at 2x. The search's s2-3 copy of this file is unreadable because the server sends it brotli-encoded (content-encoding: br) and it was saved still encoded; src5 is the same response decoded by curl --compressed, i.e. the PNG as published. DECISION: if the reviewer prefers the full-body mascot, amazingmarvin.com/images/Marvin-nobg.png (1038x962, transparent, downloads/amazing-marvin/s2-1) is the larger alternative, but it is a character illustration rather than the app icon and its dark brown is low-contrast on the dark tile.
